description: Geodata of Update: Flood Water over Tokwe Mukorsi Dam, Masvingo Province, Zimbabwe is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). This map illustrates satellite-detected water bodies at the Tokwe Mukorsi Dam, Masvingo Province, Zimbabwe, as imaged by TerraSAR-X on 18 February 2014. The flooded area above the dam has decreased slightly since the previous analysis using an image from 11 February 2014 and currently encompasses about 2,278 ha. Coverage: Zimbabwe. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are geodata. It offers 3 resource(s) in KMZ, SHP. The portal shows 2025-11-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
